title: SolidBit Hard Local Policy Specification v1
description: Inviolable local machine security boundary for SACL V1. Hard deny always wins. Bounded human approvals cannot override hard denies.

hard_denies.description: Immutable denials enforced by the local execution host. When set to true, the action is unconditionally denied.

remote_production_execution.description: Deny live execution or deployment against remote production environments (Railway, cloud hosts, remote endpoints).

github_merge.description: Deny automated git merge operations into protected branches or automated PR merge actions.

production_db_write.description: Deny destructive queries, writes, or schema alterations against shared or production databases.

secret_export.description: Deny inspection, reading, extraction, or transmission of API secrets, keys, or credentials.

arbitrary_remote_code.description: Deny arbitrary remote code execution. Packages cannot self-authorize attached scripts. Execution is restricted to locally trusted handlers.

main_branch_execution.description: Deny agent worker execution directly on main or master branches. Execution requires isolated task branches.

primary_checkout_mutation.description: Deny mutation of files within the developer's primary git checkout directory.

hard_reset.description: Deny git reset --hard or destructive git clean operations in developer workspaces.

auto_stash.description: Deny automated git stash or git stash pop operations that touch uncommitted human modifications.
